## Subjective

72yo F, established patient with HFpEF (EF 60%) + HTN + T2DM, here for 3-month maintenance follow-up (location: chest; quality: stable, no new sx; duration: 3 yrs h/o stable). Reports stable functional capacity — walks 1/2 mile daily without dyspnea, no orthopnea, no PND, no new edema. Compliant with all meds: metoprolol succ, losartan, spironolactone, metformin, atorvastatin. PMH: HFpEF, HTN, T2DM. FHx: father CHF. SHx: never smoker, no EtOH.

Constitutional: denies fatigue. CV: denies chest pain, palpitations. Resp: denies SOB.

## Objective

VS: BP 128/76, HR 68 (regular), RR 14, weight stable. Gen: NAD, well-appearing. HEENT: no JVD. Cardiac: RRR no m/r/g, no S3. Lungs: CTAB. Abdomen: soft, NT, no HSM. Extremities: no edema, distal pulses 2+. Skin: no acute changes. Neuro: A&O×3.

## Assessment

1. Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, stable (I50.32)
2. Essential hypertension, controlled (I10)
3. Type 2 diabetes mellitus, controlled (E11.9)

## Plan

Reviewed labs from 3 months ago: BMP Cr 1.0, K 4.2, BNP 320 (stable from baseline), A1c 6.8. Continue metoprolol succ 50mg daily, losartan 50mg daily, spironolactone 25mg daily, metformin 1000mg BID, atorvastatin 40mg daily — all 90-day refills, no dose changes. Continue daily weight log + sodium restriction. F/u 3 months.
